rt.title: Reproduction number (Rt)
rt.explain: Rt is the average number of people infected by one case. Above 1, cases grow. Below 1, cases shrink.
rt.explain2: Each value belongs to the end of its 7-day window. The 95% credible interval matters more than the single number.
